title: rawSourceOf's fallback in mdxHazardFindings points the UNSAFE way
description:
Filed from the LCLI-663 review (opum-control review.recorded seq 7977, run job-0ac7fxs), which flagged it as a MINOR, non-blocking finding because the branch is unreachable today.

THE DEFECT. src/core/check.ts mdxHazardFindings reads `const raw = rawSourceOf(node, source) ?? node.value;`. rawSourceOf returns null only when a text node carries no numeric position offsets. In exactly that case the fallback re-scans mdast's DECODED value -- so a source `{` (decoded to `{`) or `<` (decoded to `<`) would be flagged again, re-introducing the very false positive LCLI-663 exists to remove. The direction is the wrong one: where the raw source cannot be read, the safe default is NOT to flag, because a false positive here is the whole bug LCLI-663 fixed, and a missed hazard is at worst a missed warning.

WHY IT IS NOT URGENT. mdast-util-from-markdown records offsets by default; the reviewer probed every fixture node in LCLI-663 AC#1/AC#2 and each carried a span, so no caller reaches the branch today. It is dead code that would misbehave if the parser configuration ever changed.

SUGGESTED FIX: make the fallback fail SAFE -- skip the node, or treat it as clean -- and pin it with a test whose text node has NO position offsets (a hand-built node passed to mdxHazardFindings, or a parser call with position disabled), so the direction is asserted rather than assumed.

NOT STAMPED: no assignee; opum-doc decides whether it is dispatched.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Where a text node carries no numeric position offsets, mdxHazardFindings no longer falls back to the mdast decoded value; the fallback fails SAFE (skip the node or treat it as clean), so an entity source such as { or < cannot be re-flagged.
A test pins the direction with a text node that has NO position offsets.
